description: Source code for the ReceiverTracker class in Apache Spark Streaming, managing receiver execution, registration, deregistration, and communication within the streaming scheduler.

classes.name: ReceiverState
classes.description: Enumeration to identify current state of a Receiver (INACTIVE, SCHEDULED, ACTIVE)

classes.name: ReceiverTracker
classes.description: Manages execution, registration, deregistration, and communication of receivers in Spark Streaming

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the ReceiverTracker, setting up RPC endpoint and launching receivers

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ReceiverTracker, optionally gracefully, shutting down receivers and RPC endpoint

methods.name: allocateBlocksToBatch
methods.description: Allocates unprocessed blocks to a specific batch time

methods.name: getBlocksOfBatch
methods.description: Retrieves blocks for a given batch time across all input streams

methods.name: getBlocksOfBatchAndStream
methods.description: Retrieves blocks for a specific batch time and stream ID

methods.name: cleanupOldBlocksAndBatches
methods.description: Cleans up old block data and metadata older than a threshold time

methods.name: allocatedExecutors
methods.description: Returns a map of receiver IDs to their assigned executor IDs

methods.name: numReceivers
methods.description: Returns the number of receiver input streams

methods.name: registerReceiver
methods.description: Registers a new receiver with given parameters, returns success status

methods.name: deregisterReceiver
methods.description: Deregisters a receiver and logs the event

methods.name: sendRateUpdate
methods.description: Updates the maximum ingestion rate for a receiver

methods.name: addBlock
methods.description: Adds a received block to the tracker

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Reports an error from a receiver

methods.name: scheduleReceiver
methods.description: Schedules a receiver to run on an executor

methods.name: updateReceiverScheduledExecutors
methods.description: Updates scheduled executors for a receiver

methods.name: hasUnallocatedBlocks
methods.description: Checks if there are unprocessed received blocks

methods.name: getExecutors
methods.description: Returns list of available executors excluding the driver

methods.name: runDummySparkJob
methods.description: Runs a dummy Spark job to ensure executors are registered

methods.name: launchReceivers
methods.description: Distributes receivers to worker nodes and starts them

methods.name: isTrackerStarted
methods.description: Checks if the tracker has been started

methods.name: isTrackerStopping
methods.description: Checks if the tracker is stopping

methods.name: isTrackerStopped
methods.description: Checks if the tracker has been stopped
